# Clause sequence {#clause-sequence-sitting}

### Sequence (`-n`, clause only) {#clause-sequence}
<a id="sequence"></a>

When English tells events in time order (*and then*), put ending `-n` on a clause join (`/x/`), so narrative *and then* is **`xan`**. Like every clause join, it goes [between](joins.md#clause-joins) the clauses, so `A xan B xan C` reads one step at a time. All the clauses share one speech act: an act word on `/y/` goes before the first clause only, and the later clauses leave it out. Here `-n` orders the clauses; it does not mark a name.

<!-- cheat-sheet: joins-hooks -->
| Ageben | Use | English | Cue |
|--------|-----|---------|-----|
| `xan` | sequence add | *and then…* | `a` ≈ add |
| `xen` | sequence menu | *or maybe…*; *failing that…* | `e` ≈ choice |
| `xun` | sequence deny | *and then not…* | `u` ≈ undo |

> `zazozon vehohel xan zazozor vowurol.`
>
> [z-Azozon | v-sit | x-and-then | z-←Azozon | v-walk]
>
> "Azozon sat, and then they walked."

### Practice {#beginner-practice}

Short drills for Beginner. Try each item before opening **Show answer**.

**Setting:** a stairwell

**New words:**

| English | Ageben | Cue |
|---------|--------|-----|
| *rain* | `erulal` | 🌧️ |
| *east-west* | `ehol` | ↔️ |

**Review:**

| English | Ageben |
|---------|--------|
| *Azozon* | `azozon` |
| *Alazun* | `alazun` |
| *Ahelan* | `ahelan` |
| *run* | `veruvol` |
| *sit* | `vehohel` |
| *punch* | `vabuvul` |
| *scream* | `vozumul` |
| *window* | `uwohel` |
| *open* | `vohel` |
| *see* | `vayebel` |
| *train* | `edavol` |

#### English → Ageben {#beginner-english-to-ageben}

**1.** *Azozon runs, then Alazun sits.*

::: details Show answer
`zazozon veruvol xan zalazun vehohel.`

[z-Azozon | v-run | x-and-then | z-Alazun | v-sit]
:::

**2.** *Ahelan sits, then Azozon runs.*

::: details Show answer
`zahelan vehohel xan zazozon veruvol.`

[z-Ahelan | v-sit | x-and-then | z-Azozon | v-run]
:::

**3.** *Azozon punches, then Alazun screams.*

::: details Show answer
`zazozon vabuvul xan zalazun vozumul.`

[z-Azozon | v-punch | x-and-then | z-Alazun | v-scream]
:::

**4.** *Ahelan opens the window, then Azozon sees the rain.*

::: details Show answer
`zahelan duwohel vohel xan zazozon derulal vayebel.`

[z-Ahelan | d-window | v-open | x-and-then | z-Azozon | d-rain | v-see]
:::

**5.** *Ahelan sits, then Azozon sees the east-west train.*

::: details Show answer
`zahelan vehohel xan zazozon dedavol gehol vayebel.`

[z-Ahelan | v-sit | x-and-then | z-Azozon | [d-train | g-east-west] | v-see]
:::

#### Ageben → English {#beginner-ageben-to-english}

**1.** `zahelan vozumul xan zalazun vabuvul.`

::: details Show answer
[z-Ahelan | v-scream | x-and-then | z-Alazun | v-punch]

*Ahelan screams, then Alazun punches.*
:::

**2.** `zazozon veruvol xan zalazun veruvol.`

::: details Show answer
[z-Azozon | v-run | x-and-then | z-Alazun | v-run]

*Azozon runs, then Alazun runs.*
:::

**3.** `zalazun vehohel xan zahelan veruvol.`

::: details Show answer
[z-Alazun | v-sit | x-and-then | z-Ahelan | v-run]

*Alazun sits, then Ahelan runs.*
:::

**4.** `zalazun dedavol gehol vayebel xan zahelan veruvol.`

::: details Show answer
[z-Alazun | [d-train | g-east-west] | v-see | x-and-then | z-Ahelan | v-run]

*Alazun sees the east-west train, then Ahelan runs.*
:::

#### Pick one {#beginner-pick-one}

**1.** *Azozon sits, then Ahelan punches.* `zazozon vehohel xan zahelan vabuvul.` or `zazozon vehohel xam zahelan vabuvul.`

::: details Show answer
`zazozon vehohel xan zahelan vabuvul.`

[z-Azozon | v-sit | x-and-then | z-Ahelan | v-punch]

**-n** orders the steps; **`xam`** adds a clause without saying which came first.
:::

#### Fix it {#beginner-fix-it}

**1.** *Ahelan runs, then Alazun sits.* <!-- lint: error -->`zahelan veruvol xam zalazun vehohel.`

::: details Show answer
`zahelan veruvol xan zalazun vehohel.`

[z-Ahelan | v-run | x-and-then | z-Alazun | v-sit]

Narrative *and then* is **-n** on the clause join; **`xam`** adds a clause without ordering the steps.
:::
